meta.title: Tamga Network · The digital trust network for the Turkic world
meta.description: Tamga Network is the digital trust network for the Turkic world. Credentials issued by institutions can be verified across borders in seconds while the person's privacy stays protected, under open rules and signed lists, aligned with EU standards.
meta.ogDescription: Tamga Network is the digital trust network for the Turkic world, built on open rules and signed trust lists and aligned with EU standards.
